equivalence_matrix.evidence: The baseline and frozen contract both name The AI Scientist-v2.
The contract binds scientist_agent_baseline and its frozen SHA-256 exactly matches the current baseline artifact.
The baseline records observed_at 2026-08-23 and names its paper, implementation, and peer-reviewed-report locators.
The baseline names publications and an implementation repository but no immutable configuration identifier binding code revision, provider/model matrix, sandbox, stages, and reviewer configuration.
The baseline reports one externally reviewed workshop-threshold success among three submissions, but the frozen positive-control task set is a separate O comparison study and has no matched receipt.
The baseline describes the reported original system, but the missing immutable configuration prevents proving that it is identical or fidelity-equivalent to the frozen comparison conditions.
The baseline contains descriptive findings for all six named rubric dimensions; this supports dimension coverage only, not a matched PASS.
No baseline field or receipt binds the frozen task-set digest 64573270e341883b983fbd65410c4700ecb4b241db58249bf8dbc0ffd56e2d70.
Author-reported approximate cost and duration do not bind the frozen budget digest 2601bdbcc74dc9c34451f81456812c6437b8329f4bd9f43cf226a2e74ad951df or its replay count and matched-arm limits.
The baseline does not prove the frozen model/executor-class identity or a documented equivalence mapping.
The artifact contains narrative demonstrated results but no canonical result digest for a receipt satisfying the frozen contract.
Because configuration, task, budget, executor, and matched-result bindings are absent, a truthful complete equivalence basis cannot be constructed.

validator_outcome.reason: The validator requires exact fidelity, task-set, budget, model/executor, PASS-result, result-digest, configuration, and provenance bindings. Several are absent from the frozen baseline artifact, so emitting an object merely to make validation pass would fabricate equivalence.

duplicate_reproduction_policy.rule: Do not repeat a positive control when equivalent original conditions are adequately proven. Here equivalence is not proven, but this audit alone does not schedule a reproduction.
duplicate_reproduction_policy.later_control_required_only_for: A later causal claim that must distinguish failure of the original method from loss introduced by an O adaptation or ablation under matched conditions.
duplicate_reproduction_policy.independent_work_allowed: Continue other falsifiable work and classify any result only within its named tested candidate, configuration, and conditions.
